fixed_reference_contract_for_later_gates.scope: Registered only. Phase 0.2 stores R0 metadata but does not implement feature mapping, scoring, reference writes or budget commits.

protocol_conventions.task_id: Monotonically increasing integer within one protocol instance; never reused after failure/termination.
protocol_conventions.identity: Trusted simulator transport identity must match issued identity and packet identity.
protocol_conventions.outstanding: Issued plus arrived/buffer-waiting tasks; per identity at most one.
protocol_conventions.capacity: Candidate buffer <= K; excess legal arrivals remain in FIFO ingress, retaining outstanding slots.
protocol_conventions.coefficient: Explicit test/caller input; 0 <= a_i <= eta_M/(1+current_version-source_version)/K. No score is inferred.
protocol_conventions.small_batch_denominator: Configured K, never the received/retained count.
protocol_conventions.version: Positive-coefficient commit sequence, not nonzero floating-point displacement.
protocol_conventions.ledger: Model-channel consumption receipts only; shared a+b sliding-budget ledger is deferred to 0.4.
protocol_conventions.late_packet: Does not terminate or consume a newly issued task of the same identity.
protocol_conventions.reference_storage: Frozen tuple metadata initialized at R0; reference stays unchanged in this model-only gate.
